minutes.headline: Planning Board let the Northfield Road scenic road applicant withdraw without prejudice to refile with engineered plans.
minutes.summary: The board held a remote scenic road hearing on driveways and tree removal on Northfield Road. Members said the plans were too sketchy and that an extra parcel was not in the advertised notice, so the applicant withdrew without prejudice to re-advertise. The board also approved prior minutes, released the O'Brien executive session minutes, heard committee reports and director's items, and discussed stormwater bylaw standards.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board accepted the withdrawal, without prejudice, of the Northfield Road scenic road application on driveways and tree removal.
Members said the plans were too sketchy and that an extra parcel was missing from the advertised notice, so the hearing is to be re-advertised with engineered plans.
The board voted to release the executive session minutes in the O'Brien Homes matter for all dates listed on the agenda.
The board agreed to add the stormwater permit disturbance threshold to a future agenda, to be discussed with the stormwater bylaw.
The board plans to review the subdivision rules and regulations in a workshop or chapter by chapter on lighter agendas.

why_it_matters: Neighbors of Northfield Road, a designated scenic road, will get a new notice and another hearing before any driveway or tree removal work is approved.
The stormwater bylaw and subdivision rules shape how land is developed and how runoff is handled in town, and changes to them could come before residents as bylaw proposals.
watch_next: August 10 Planning Board meeting, expected to cover stormwater and low impact development; members are to send comments by the Wednesday before.
The re-advertised Northfield Road scenic road hearing, to include the added parcel and engineered plans.
